No. 1958/74– FRIDAY, MARCH, 18, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Reference No.:

I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the land or servitude to be acquired:

Allotments below name land in total extent of about 0.0255 Hectares, shown in Final Topographical Plan No. 13, Supplement No. 8, Sheet No. 18 and dated 26.11.2015, prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys, Kurunegala District on behalf of the Surveyor General, situated on the village of Pulanchiya in the Grama Niladari Division of No. 89, Senarathgama and Minor Division of Hathalispaha Batahira Korale in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Galgamuwa, in the District of Kurunegala in North Western Province.
01. Lot No. 714
Name of the Land: —; Land Use: Road (Road Development Authority); Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Required for development of Padeniya, Anuradhapura Road; Extent: 0.0216 Hectare.
02. Lot No. 716

Name of the Land: Palugahahena; Land Use: Open waste Land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Pathirannehelage Punchirala Senarathgama, Mahagal-kadawala. (Possessed by Pathiranage Lional Kumara); Extent: 0.0008 Hectare.
03. Lot No. 717

Name of the Land: Palugahahena; Land Use: Open waste Land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Pathirannehelage Punchirala Senarathgama, Mahagal-kadawala. (Possessed by Pathiranage Nishantha Pradeep Kumara); Extent: 0.0031 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands* on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Galgamuwa of the 15th May, 2016 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 25th April, 2016 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude*, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
P. M. S. P. PATHIRAJA, Divisional Secretary, Galgamuwa.
Divisional Secretariat, Galgamuwa. 16th March 2016
